Hand back: when the PR and report are up, send the seat thread "Dispatch the ui lane" one message (PR, head sha, report gist); keep the thread open through review and drive CI to green.

### Ruling (cannot be re-ruled)

Triage first grade 6447119250, verbatim: "**p2:** publish refusals show only as a ~4 s toast with engine-internal text, the Pending changes panel keeps none, and "Show me" does not focus the input. Keep the refusal in the panel until resolved, in author terms, and focus the field. … Re-check the landing site on current `main`." No maintainer ruling.

### PM mechanism assumptions (measure; disproof welcome)

On `origin/main` `5ec398dc` (after #26845 landed), in `ui/packages/app-shell/src/views/studio-design/StudioDesignSurface.tsx`:
- `doPublish` (≈L1448) reports a `failed[]` publish only as `toast.error(formatPublishFailures(failed))` (≈L1478 org scope, ≈L1552 package). Nothing keeps `failed` after the toast, so `DraftChangesPanel` (`ui/packages/app-shell/src/preview/DraftChangesPanel.tsx`, props ≈L907) never sees it. The likely fix keeps the last publish's failures in surface state, passes them to the panel, and shows each failure on its entry (type/name). Clear one when that entry is re-saved, leaves the pending list, or a later publish succeeds for it. Measure whether `BATCH_ABORTED` consequences need their own line; the cause entry is the one the author fixes.
- "Engine-internal text": `formatPublishFailures` (`metadataError.ts` ≈L79) prints `type/name: error` plus raw issue lines. `StudioRefusal` (same file, objectui#11785) already turns a save failure into an author sentence, a target, and the raw text behind "Details". Measure whether a publish failure's `issues` can go through the same reader, and reuse it rather than adding a third formatter. ⛔ `formatMetadataError` is not changed. Do not rewrite server text; put it behind Details.
- "Show me": strips at ≈L4683 (Interfaces pillar `error`: no `onShow`, which covers the dashboard/report case), ≈L6483 (Data, `showObjTarget` ≈L5589 only selects), and ≈L8130 (Automations). Measure where focus lands after `onShow`; the likely fix moves focus to the target's input once the inspector has rendered it. Give the Interfaces strip an `onShow` where its refusal carries a target.

### Scope

File surface: `StudioDesignSurface.tsx`, `DraftChangesPanel.tsx`, `metadataError.ts`, the inspectors only where a focus hook is needed, i18n rows in the lazy `studio` namespace (a zh test preloads with `await loadStudioCatalogue('zh')`), and tests. Tests: a refused publish leaves the refusal on its Pending changes entry after the toast is gone, worded by the refusal reader, with the raw text under Details; re-saving or a successful publish clears it; "Show me" from Data, Automations and Interfaces (a dashboard or report target) puts `document.activeElement` on the offending input; a successful publish shows no refusal. Ablation: drop the kept-failures state, then drop the focus move; each turns its tests red. ⛔ No change to publish gating, the held-edit guard, or server text.

Serial: open PR #26920 (another lane, #26708) edits `StudioDesignSurface.tsx` near L1270–1330 (package not-found), which is disjoint from these regions. #26733 (rail empty-search) runs in parallel on the rail call sites (≈L5104/6341/7969/8892), also disjoint. Whoever lands second merges `origin/main`.

### Tier

No path-derived mandate. `TIER_DEFAULT`, effort `high` (M–L). `Clause-②: no`, `Metadata-protocol: none` expected. Patch changeset for `@object-ui/i18n` if you add namespace rows; none for app-shell (`private: true`).
